t.zh: 桌上有一堆石子。两个人轮流拿，每次拿 1 颗或 2 颗，拿走最后一颗的人赢。轮到你先拿，你能赢吗？
t.en: There is a pile of stones on the table. Two players take turns, taking 1 or 2 stones each time, and whoever takes the last stone wins. You go first. Can you win?

t.zh: 把「还剩几颗」排成一行，每一格记：轮到你、还剩这么多颗时，你能不能赢。一颗不剩时轮到你，说明对手刚拿走了最后一颗：你输了。
t.en: Lay out “how many are left” in a row, and let each cell record: with this many left and your turn to move, can you win? If it is your turn and none are left, your opponent has just taken the last stone: you have lost.

t.zh: 只看你这一步：拿 1 颗，对手面对「拿走 1 颗后」那一格；拿 2 颗，对手面对「拿走 2 颗后」那一格。想一想：对手面对的格子是「是」还是「否」的时候，你才能赢？两种拿法里，要几种行得通才够？
t.en: Look only at your own move: take 1, and your opponent faces the “after taking 1” cell; take 2, and they face the “after taking 2” cell. Think: is the cell your opponent faces “yes” or “no” when you can win? Of the two ways to take, how many have to work?

t.zh: 新元件「取反」：「是」变「否」，「否」变「是」。格子里记的是「轮到的人能不能赢」。你拿完以后，轮到的是谁？
t.en: A new component, “Not”: “yes” becomes “no”, and “no” becomes “yes”. Each cell records “can the player to move win”. After you take your stones, whose move is it?

goal.zh: 每次拿 1 颗或 2 颗，拿走最后一颗的人赢。算出石子还剩几颗时，轮到的人能不能赢。
goal.en: Take 1 or 2 stones each time; whoever takes the last stone wins. For each number of stones left, work out whether the player to move can win.

how.zh: 这一关会检查整行。在视野里点「拿走 1 颗后」和「拿走 2 颗后」，拼出电路。
how.en: This level checks the whole row. Click “after taking 1” and “after taking 2” in the view, and build the circuit.

title.en: Winning and losing fill a table too

body.zh: 一颗不剩那一格，你什么都不用接：一步也走不了，「任一是」什么也收不到，输出「否」。无路可走的人就输了。
body.en: For the “none left” cell you don’t need to wire anything: there is no move to make, “any yes” receives nothing, and it outputs “no”. A player with no move left loses.

body.zh: 看看这一行：否、是、是、否、是、是……每逢 3 的倍数就输。你没有算任何除法，规律是表自己长出来的。
body.en: Look at the row: no, yes, yes, no, yes, yes… every multiple of 3 loses. You never did any division: the pattern grew out of the table by itself.

note.zh: 轮流走的游戏：只要有一步能让对手落进「输」，这一格就「赢」。
note.en: In a game of taking turns: if any move drops the opponent into a “lose”, this cell is a “win”.

say.zh: 你拿完之后，轮到谁走？格子里记的是「轮到的人能不能赢」，对手的「是」对你来说是「否」。用取反翻过来。
say.en: After your move, whose turn is it? Each cell records “can the player to move win”, so your opponent’s “yes” is a “no” for you. Flip it with Not.

hints.zh: 你拿完之后，轮到谁走？对手那一格是「是」，对你来说意味着什么？
hints.en: After your move, whose turn is it? If the opponent’s cell is “yes”, what does that mean for you?

hints.zh: 两种拿法，只要有一种让对手输，你就赢：两个取反都接进「任一是」。
hints.en: Of the two ways to take, if either leaves the opponent losing, you win: wire both Nots into “any yes”.
